facts.material: filter media (assumed nonwoven textile) in a plastic housing
facts.function: removes airborne particulates from air drawn into a powered air purifying respirator
facts.form: replaceable high efficiency (HE) particulate filter cartridge
facts.end_use: worker respiratory protection with the 3M GVP powered air purifying respirator

gri_path: GRI 1: candidate headings 8421 (filtering apparatus for gases), 9020 (breathing appliances and parts) and 5911 (textile articles for technical uses, filtering)

Section XVI note 1(e): Section XVI does not cover articles of textile material for technical uses of heading 5911, so a textile-media filter is excluded from 8421; chapter 90 note 2 would in any event send a filter to its own heading rather than 9020
Chapter 59 note on heading 5911: textile articles for technical uses such as filtering; GRI 6: 5911.90.00 other; suffix .80 other

rejected_alternatives.reason: Section XVI note 1(e) excludes textile technical articles of 5911 (N253050 rejected 8421.39 for a 3M respirator filter on this ground); would apply only if the media is not textile (e.g., glass fiber paper)
parts of breathing appliances; a filter that is a good of another specific heading is not classified as a part under chapter 90 note 2
made-up textile articles yield to 5911 for technical filtering articles

missing_facts: What is the filter medium (nonwoven textile vs glass-fiber or paper media)? A non-textile medium would point to 8421.39.
classification.rationale: The GVP-440 is a replaceable particulate filter for a 3M powered air purifying respirator. NY N253050 (in force) classified a 3M respirator particulate filter cartridge in 5911.90.0080, holding that Section XVI note 1(e) excludes textile technical filtering articles from heading 8421. Following that precedent for a like 3M filter, the line is 5911.90.00.80; if the medium proves non-textile, 8421.39 would apply instead.
